assertions.name: adjacent_single_letters_factorise_too_so_that_control_is_worthless
assertions.note: a word using each generator ONCE in INCREASING order is collapsed one generator at a time by the Markov property, adjacency or not. Reading this as a positive result would have been an overclaim

assertions.name: a_REPEATED_generator_does_break_multiplicativity
assertions.note: so the test below has teeth: the quadratic relation sigma^2 = h.sigma + 1 bites exactly where a generator repeats

assertions.name: braid_words_on_disjoint_nonadjacent_blocks_factorise_exactly
assertions.note: exact to the working precision, with generators repeated INSIDE each block -- so this is not the Markov property in disguise

assertions.name: the_two_layout_demands_are_incompatible
assertions.note: a nucleon's three strands cannot be simultaneously adjacent (for the intra-nucleon crossings) and A apart (for colour-blocked inter-nucleon coupling). The colour tube is blocked by the strand ORDERING, not by the trace -- the trace cooperates exactly

parameters.engine: build_seminormal_matrices_mp (exact-precision, NOT the float64 chi_lambda_of_word kernel)

control_adjacent_single_letters.note: factorises anyway — the Markov property, not a control
